title: Forms
slide_intent: Show how to introduce a new identity to a working form while preserving the familiar fields people use to complete it.
strategic_value: NASA can identify the issuer during the transition before the form itself is redesigned.
demonstration: A shipping receipt carries the NASA mark and agency identification above its existing ruled fields, item table and signature area.
practical_value: Use the example to place the identification on an existing form and preserve the field order during the interim rollout.

content_islands.name: Transition note
content_islands.spec: Place the title and two brief notes across the top explaining the interim treatment and later redesign.

content_islands.name: Shipping receipt
content_islands.spec: Below the note, show the complete form with its mark at upper left, a heavy rule above the fields, ample item-entry space and receipt instructions at the foot.
